10	/-!
11	# The certificate's kernel-spanning input, with the submodule eliminated
12	
13	The certificate assemblers take a submodule `L ≤ ker (δ_left − δ_right)` together with the
14	fibrewise-spanning law `hspan`.  Choosing `L` is not where the difficulty lies: the
15	canonical choice `L = ker (δ_left − δ_right)` always satisfies `hle` by `le_rfl`, and for
16	that choice `hspan` is *equivalent* to residue-fibre injectivity of the injectivized map
17	(`ker_rTensor_le_range_subtype_iff_liftQ_rTensor_injective`).
18	
19	This file records the resulting assembler interfaces, which mention no submodule at all.
20	It is a packaging step, not a weakening: the remaining content is the fibre injectivity,
21	which the syzygy file already shows is equivalent to the flat-cokernel clause and so
22	genuinely needs relative geometry (it is not evadable by a cleverer choice of `L`).
23	
24	Combined with `DivSchemeCertZarTube.lean`, the certificate obligation over an `Away` chart
25	is now exactly two fibrewise facts: support containment in a piece, and injectivity of the
26	injectivized Čech difference on each residue fibre.
27	
28	## Main declarations
29	
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_of_noLeak_of_forall_liftQ_injective` —
31	  the assembler with `L` eliminated.
32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ThetaGeneratorSeed.divisorAdaptation_isCertified_of_noLeak_liftQ_degree`
33	  — the seed form, with the degree input in the landed pulled-divisor spelling.
34	-/
35	
36	set_option autoImplicit false
37	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
38	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

40	universe u
41	
42	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
43	open scoped TensorProduct

45	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
46	
47	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
48	
49	namespace DivisorAdaptation
50	
51	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom]
52	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
53	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
54	variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
55	variable (A : DivisorAdaptation C R pi d)
56	
57	/-- **The assembler with the spanning submodule eliminated.** Taking `L` to be the actual
58	kernel of the Čech difference makes `hle` trivial and turns `hspan` into residue-fibre
59	injectivity of the injectivized map — so the certificate needs no invented submodule.
60	
61	The remaining hypothesis `hinj` is genuine relative content: the syzygy file proves it
62	equivalent to the flat-cokernel clause, hence not evadable by choosing `L` differently. -/
63	theorem isCertified_of_noLeak_of_forall_liftQ_injective [IsNoetherianRing R] {n : ℕ}
64	    (hnoLeak : ∀ (j : A.index) (s : Spec (.of R)),
65	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s}
66	          ∩ closure (d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) ⊆
67	        (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
68	    (hregular : ∀ (j : A.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum R),
69	      (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
70	          Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
71	        nonZeroDivisors
72	          (Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
73	    (hovlFinite : Module.Finite R A.ovlProd)
74	    (hovlFlat : Module.Flat R A.ovlProd)
75	    (hinj : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
76	      Function.Injective
77	        (((LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)).liftQ
78	          (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) le_rfl).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
79	    (hdim : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
80	      Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
81	          (LinearMap.ker
82	            ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight).baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) = n) :
83	    A.IsCertified n :=
84	  A.isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning hnoLeak hregular hovlFinite hovlFlat
85	    (LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) le_rfl
86	    (fun p => (ker_rTensor_le_range_subtype_iff_liftQ_rTensor_injective
87	      (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) p.asIdeal.ResidueField).mpr (hinj p))
88	    hdim
89	
90	end DivisorAdaptation

92	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
93	
94	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
95	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
96	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
97	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
98	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
99	variable {a : ℕ} {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R pi a)}
100	variable {D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R pi a K} (hD : D.IsGenerator)
101	
102	noncomputable local instance instIsIntegralRelCurveCertKerSpan
103	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
104	  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
105	
106	noncomputable local instance instSmoothRelCurveCertKerSpan
107	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
108	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
109	  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
110	
111	noncomputable local instance instQCRelCurveCertKerSpan
112	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
113	    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
114	  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
115	
116	local notation "A" => D.divisorAdaptation hD
117	
118	/-- **The seed certificate with no invented submodule and the landed degree input.** The
119	three substantive inputs are now: fibrewise no-leak (produced Zariski-locally by the
120	support tube, `DivSchemeCertZarTube.lean`), residue-fibre injectivity of the injectivized
121	Čech difference, and the degree of every pulled presentation divisor (already proved for
122	the pointwise generator seed). -/
123	theorem divisorAdaptation_isCertified_of_noLeak_liftQ_degree {n : ℕ}
124	    (hnoLeak : ∀ (j : (A).index) (s : Spec (.of R)),
125	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s}
126	          ∩ closure
127	            ((D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ∩
128	              ((A).pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) ⊆
129	        ((A).pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
130	    (hinj : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
131	      Function.Injective
132	        (((LinearMap.ker ((A).deltaLeft - (A).deltaRight)).liftQ
133	          ((A).deltaLeft - (A).deltaRight) le_rfl).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
134	    (hdeg : ∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
135	      (hproj : ∀ j : (A).index, Module.Projective R ((A).colength j)),
136	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
137	          (Scheme.presentationDivisor p.asIdeal.ResidueField
138	            (((A).pulledEquations p.asIdeal.ResidueField hproj).presentation)) =
139	        (n : ℤ)) :
140	    (A).IsCertified n :=
141	  D.divisorAdaptation_isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning_degree hD hnoLeak
142	    (LinearMap.ker ((A).deltaLeft - (A).deltaRight)) le_rfl
143	    (fun p => (ker_rTensor_le_range_subtype_iff_liftQ_rTensor_injective
144	      ((A).deltaLeft - (A).deltaRight) p.asIdeal.ResidueField).mpr (hinj p))
145	    hdeg
146	
147	end ThetaGeneratorSeed
148	
149	end AlgebraicGeometry

11	/-!
12	# The support tube: the family support is closed over the base (DDR-4 finiteness input)
13	
14	The geometric half of the DDR-4 certificate clause (c1) (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3
15	item 4): for a local-equation system `d` on a scheme `X`, the **support locus** — the
16	set of points where the (well-defined, by the ratio law) germ of the local equation is
17	not a unit — is closed in `X`; over a base `S` with `X → S` universally closed (the
18	standing `IsProper C.hom`, base-changed to the relative curve over every test ring),
19	its image in `S` is closed, and the **tube lemma** holds: if the support fibre over a
20	base point `s` is contained in an open `U` (e.g. a union of adaptation pieces), then so
21	is the whole support over a Zariski neighbourhood of `s` — piece isolation Zariski-locally
22	on the base.
23	
24	## Main declarations
25	
26	* `IsClosedMap.exists_isOpen_preimage_inter_subset` — the topological tube core: a
27	  closed map, a closed set `T`, an open `U` containing the `T`-fibre over `y` ⟹ an open
28	  neighbourhood `V ∋ y` with `f⁻¹(V) ∩ T ⊆ U` (via `Set.kernImage`);
29	* `Scheme.LocalEquations.unitLocus` / `supportLocus` — the (open) locus where the
30	  equations are germwise units, and its closed complement;
31	* `Scheme.LocalEquations.mem_unitLocus_iff_isUnit_germ` — membership reads on ANY
32	  covering member through the ratio law;
33	* `Scheme.LocalEquations.supportLocus_inter_opens` — the per-member trace
34	  `supp ∩ U_x = U_x \ D(eqn x)`;
35	* `Scheme.LocalEquations.isClosed_image_supportLocus`,
36	  `Scheme.LocalEquations.exists_supportTube` — closed image and the tube, for any
37	  `f : X ⟶ S` with `[UniversallyClosed f]`;
38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instIsProperRelSndLeft`, `instIsProperRelCurveHom` — **the
39	  licence**: `IsProper C.hom` base-changes to the relative curve over an arbitrary test
40	  ring `R` (the field-keyed instances of `Curve/BaseChangeInstances` generalised), so
41	  `UniversallyClosed (relCurve C R ↘ Spec R)` fires by resolution;
42	* `DivisorAdaptation.mem_basicOpen_eqn_of_mem_unitLocus` / `unitLocus_eq` /
43	  `supportLocus_inter_pieces` — the adaptation reads the SAME support: on a piece,
44	  `d`'s support trace is `D(h_j) \ D(f_j)` (through `eqn_rel`, both ways);
45	* `FinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces` — the pieces' section rings are `R`-flat;
46	* `DivisorAdaptation.flat_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField` /
47	  `projective_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField` — **the (c1) junction**: a
48	  fibrewise-regular adaptation equation has flat colength over the Noetherian test
49	  ring (the `SlicingFlat` keystone on the piece ring), and a finite colength (the
50	  support-tube finiteness input) is then projective — the two clauses of
51	  `IsCertified` (c1) for the piece `j`.
52	-/

54	set_option autoImplicit false

56	universe u

58	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
59	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
60	open scoped TensorProduct
61	
62	/-! ## The topological tube core -/
63	
64	section TubeCore
65	
66	variable {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
67	
68	/-- **The closed-map tube lemma**: for a closed map `f`, a closed `T ⊆ X` and an open
69	`U ⊆ X`, if the `T`-fibre over `y` is contained in `U` then so is `f⁻¹(V) ∩ T` for some
70	open neighbourhood `V` of `y`. Take `V := Set.kernImage f (U ∪ Tᶜ)`, open by
71	`isClosedMap_iff_kernImage`. -/
72	theorem IsClosedMap.exists_isOpen_preimage_inter_subset {f : X → Y}
73	    (hf : IsClosedMap f) {T U : Set X} (hT : IsClosed T) (hU : IsOpen U) {y : Y}
74	    (hfib : f ⁻¹' {y} ∩ T ⊆ U) :
75	    ∃ V : Set Y, IsOpen V ∧ y ∈ V ∧ f ⁻¹' V ∩ T ⊆ U := by
76	  refine ⟨Set.kernImage f (U ∪ Tᶜ),
77	    isClosedMap_iff_kernImage.mp hf (hU.union hT.isOpen_compl), ?_, ?_⟩
78	  · intro x hx
79	    by_cases hxT : x ∈ T
80	    · exact Or.inl (hfib ⟨hx, hxT⟩)
81	    · exact Or.inr hxT
82	  · rintro x ⟨hxV, hxT⟩
83	    rcases hxV (rfl : f x = f x) with h | h
84	    · exact h
85	    · exact absurd hxT h
86	
87	end TubeCore

89	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
90	
91	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
92	
93	/-! ## The support locus of a local-equation system -/
94	
95	namespace Scheme.LocalEquations
96	
97	variable {X S : Scheme.{u}} (d : X.LocalEquations)
98	
99	/-- **The unit locus** of a local-equation system: the (open) union of the basic opens
100	of the equations — the locus where the divisor cut by `d` is trivial. -/
101	def unitLocus : X.Opens := ⨆ x, X.basicOpen (d.eqn x)
102	
103	lemma basicOpen_le_unitLocus (x : X) : X.basicOpen (d.eqn x) ≤ d.unitLocus :=
104	  le_iSup (fun x => X.basicOpen (d.eqn x)) x
105	
106	/-- Membership in the unit locus reads on ANY covering member containing the point:
107	`y ∈ unitLocus` iff the germ of `eqn x` at `y` is a unit, for every member `x` with
108	`y ∈ cover.opens x` (well-definedness across members is the ratio law). -/
109	lemma mem_unitLocus_iff_isUnit_germ {x y : X} (hy : y ∈ d.cover.opens x) :
110	    y ∈ d.unitLocus
111	      ↔ IsUnit ((X.presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens x) y hy).hom (d.eqn x)) := by
112	  constructor
113	  · intro h
114	    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp h
115	    have hy' : y ∈ d.cover.opens x' := X.basicOpen_le _ hx'
116	    have hu' : IsUnit ((X.presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens x') y hy').hom (d.eqn x')) :=
117	      (X.mem_basicOpen _ y hy').mp hx'
118	    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := d.ratio_isUnit x x'
119	    have hyW : y ∈ d.cover.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x' := ⟨hy, hy'⟩
120	    have h := congrArg
121	      ((X.presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x') y hyW).hom) hu
122	    rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at h
123	    rw [h, IsUnit.mul_iff]
124	    exact ⟨u.isUnit.map _, hu'⟩
125	  · intro h
126	    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, (X.mem_basicOpen _ y hy).mpr h⟩
127	
128	/-- **The support locus** of a local-equation system: the closed set of points where
129	the (well-defined) germ of the local equation fails to be a unit — the underlying set
130	of the divisor cut by `d`. -/
131	def supportLocus : Set X := (d.unitLocus : Set X)ᶜ
132	
133	lemma isClosed_supportLocus : IsClosed d.supportLocus :=
134	  d.unitLocus.isOpen.isClosed_compl
135	
136	lemma mem_supportLocus_iff_not_isUnit_germ {x y : X} (hy : y ∈ d.cover.opens x) :
137	    y ∈ d.supportLocus
138	      ↔ ¬ IsUnit ((X.presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens x) y hy).hom (d.eqn x)) :=
139	  not_congr (d.mem_unitLocus_iff_isUnit_germ hy)
140	
141	/-- **The per-member trace of the support**: on a covering member, the support locus is
142	the member minus the basic open of its equation. -/
143	lemma supportLocus_inter_opens (x : X) :
144	    d.supportLocus ∩ (d.cover.opens x : Set X)
145	      = (d.cover.opens x : Set X) \ (X.basicOpen (d.eqn x) : Set X) := by
146	  ext y
147	  constructor
148	  · rintro ⟨hsupp, hy⟩
149	    refine ⟨hy, fun hyb => hsupp (d.basicOpen_le_unitLocus x hyb)⟩
150	  · rintro ⟨hy, hyb⟩
151	    refine ⟨fun hyU => hyb ?_, hy⟩
152	    exact (X.mem_basicOpen _ y hy).mpr ((d.mem_unitLocus_iff_isUnit_germ hy).mp hyU)
153	
154	/-- **The support is closed over the base**: the image of the support locus under a
155	universally closed morphism (e.g. the structure morphism of the relative curve, from
156	the standing `IsProper C.hom`) is closed. -/
157	theorem isClosed_image_supportLocus (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f] :
158	    IsClosed (f.base '' d.supportLocus) :=
159	  f.isClosedMap _ d.isClosed_supportLocus
160	
161	/-- **The support tube** (piece isolation, Zariski-locally on the base): for a
162	universally closed `f : X ⟶ S`, if the support fibre over a base point `s` is contained
163	in an open `U` (a union of adaptation pieces, in the DDR-4 instantiation), then there
164	is a Zariski neighbourhood `V` of `s` such that the whole support over `V` is contained
165	in `U`. -/
166	theorem exists_supportTube (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f] {U : Set X}
167	    (hU : IsOpen U) {s : S} (hfib : f.base ⁻¹' {s} ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ U) :
168	    ∃ V : S.Opens, s ∈ V ∧ f.base ⁻¹' (V : Set S) ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ U := by
169	  obtain ⟨V, hVopen, hsV, hV⟩ := (f.isClosedMap).exists_isOpen_preimage_inter_subset
170	    d.isClosed_supportLocus hU hfib
171	  exact ⟨⟨V, hVopen⟩, hsV, hV⟩
172	
173	end Scheme.LocalEquations
174	
175	/-! ## The licence: properness of the relative curve over an arbitrary test ring -/
176	
177	section RelCurveProper
178	
179	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
180	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
181	
182	/-- **Base change of properness to an arbitrary test ring**: the second projection of
183	`C ⊗ Spec R` is proper, for every commutative `k`-algebra `R` — the general-`R` form of
184	`Curve/BaseChangeInstances.instIsProperSndLeft` (which is keyed on field extensions).
185	This is the DDR-4 support-tube licence over the `Z(♦)`-chart rings `R_Z`. -/
186	instance instIsProperRelSndLeft : IsProper (snd C (overSpec k R)).left :=
187	  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsProper)
188	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k R)) inferInstance
189	
190	/-- The properness instance, keyed on the `relCurve C R ↘ Spec R` spelling installed by
191	`relCurve.instOver` (definitionally the second projection). In particular
192	`UniversallyClosed (relCurve C R ↘ Spec R)` fires by resolution, which is what
193	`Scheme.LocalEquations.exists_supportTube` consumes. -/
194	instance instIsProperRelCurveHom :
195	    IsProper ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) :=
196	  inferInstanceAs (IsProper (snd C (overSpec k R)).left)
197	
198	/-- Acceptance smoke test: the support tube applies to the relative curve over an
199	arbitrary test ring with the universally-closed instance found by resolution. -/
200	private theorem supportTube_smoke (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
201	    {U : Set (relCurve C R)} (hU : IsOpen U) {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of R)}
202	    (hfib : ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s} ∩ d.supportLocus
203	      ⊆ U) :
204	    ∃ V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens, s ∈ V ∧
205	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹' (V : Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
206	        ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ U :=
207	  d.exists_supportTube _ hU hfib
208	
209	end RelCurveProper

211	/-! ## The adaptation reads the same support, and the (c1) junction -/
212	
213	section Adaptation
214	
215	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
216	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
217	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k}
218	
219	namespace FinCoverData
220	
221	variable [IsFinite π] (D : FinCoverData C R π)
222	
223	/-- **Flatness of the piece section rings over the test ring**: each `Γ(D(h_j))` is a
224	localization of a pinned-chart ring, which is free over `R`; the `FinCoverData`
225	companion of `ThetaGeneratorSeed.flat_sections_piece`. -/
226	theorem flat_sections_pieces (j : D.index) :
227	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) := by
228	  cases j with
229	  | inl j =>
230	      exact flat_sections_basicOpen R (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
231	        (flat_sections_relPinnedChart C R π false) (D.h₀ j)
232	  | inr j =>
233	      exact flat_sections_basicOpen R (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
234	        (flat_sections_relPinnedChart C R π true) (D.h₁ j)
235	
236	end FinCoverData
237	
238	namespace DivisorAdaptation
239	
240	variable [IsAffineHom π] {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
241	variable (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
242	
243	/-- On a piece, the germ of the adaptation equation is a unit iff the germ of `d`'s
244	tautological equation is (the pointwise refinement clause `eqn_rel`, read at germs). -/
245	lemma isUnit_germ_eqn_iff (j : A.index) {w : relCurve C R} (hwj : w ∈ A.pieces j) :
246	    IsUnit (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j) w hwj).hom (A.eqn j))
247	      ↔ IsUnit (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens w) w
248	          (d.cover.mem_opens w)).hom (d.eqn w)) := by
249	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := A.eqn_rel j w
250	  have hwW : w ∈ A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens w := ⟨hwj, d.cover.mem_opens w⟩
251	  have h := congrArg
252	    (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens w) w hwW).hom) hu
253	  rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at h
254	  rw [h, IsUnit.mul_iff]
255	  exact and_iff_right (u.isUnit.map _)
256	
257	/-- On a piece, membership in `d`'s unit locus is membership in the basic open of the
258	adaptation equation. -/
259	lemma mem_basicOpen_eqn_iff_mem_unitLocus (j : A.index) {w : relCurve C R}
260	    (hwj : w ∈ A.pieces j) :
261	    w ∈ (relCurve C R).basicOpen (A.eqn j) ↔ w ∈ d.unitLocus := by
262	  rw [(relCurve C R).mem_basicOpen _ w hwj, A.isUnit_germ_eqn_iff j hwj]
263	  exact (d.mem_unitLocus_iff_isUnit_germ (d.cover.mem_opens w)).symm
264	
265	/-- The adaptation's basic opens land in `d`'s unit locus. -/
266	lemma basicOpen_eqn_le_unitLocus (j : A.index) :
267	    (relCurve C R).basicOpen (A.eqn j) ≤ d.unitLocus := fun _ hw =>
268	  (A.mem_basicOpen_eqn_iff_mem_unitLocus j
269	    ((relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (A.eqn j) hw)).mp hw
270	
271	/-- **The adaptation computes the unit locus**: the union of the basic opens of the
272	adaptation equations IS `d`'s unit locus (so the adaptation and the system cut the same
273	support). Uses that the pieces cover the relative curve (`exists_mem_pieces`). -/
274	lemma iSup_basicOpen_eqn_eq_unitLocus :
275	    (⨆ j, (relCurve C R).basicOpen (A.eqn j)) = d.unitLocus := by
276	  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun j => A.basicOpen_eqn_le_unitLocus j) ?_
277	  intro w hw
278	  obtain ⟨j, hwj⟩ := A.toFinCoverData.exists_mem_pieces w
279	  exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨j, (A.mem_basicOpen_eqn_iff_mem_unitLocus j hwj).mpr hw⟩
280	
281	/-- **The per-piece trace of the family support**: on the piece `D(h_j)`, the support
282	locus of the family is exactly `D(h_j) \ D(f_j)` — the underlying set of the colength
283	`Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_j)`. This is the shape the DDR-4 finiteness argument consumes: the
284	piece trace of the globally closed (and, over the base, properly closed) support. -/
285	lemma supportLocus_inter_pieces (j : A.index) :
286	    d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))
287	      = (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))
288	        \ ((relCurve C R).basicOpen (A.eqn j) : Set (relCurve C R)) := by
289	  ext w
290	  constructor
291	  · rintro ⟨hsupp, hwj⟩
292	    exact ⟨hwj, fun hwb => hsupp (A.basicOpen_eqn_le_unitLocus j hwb)⟩
293	  · rintro ⟨hwj, hwb⟩
294	    exact ⟨fun hwU => hwb ((A.mem_basicOpen_eqn_iff_mem_unitLocus j hwj).mpr hwU), hwj⟩
295	
296	end DivisorAdaptation
297	
298	namespace DivisorAdaptation

300	/-! ### The (c1) junction: flat, then finite projective, colengths -/
301	
302	section Junction
303	
304	variable [IsFinite π] {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
305	variable (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
306	
307	/-- **The (c1) flatness clause from fibrewise regularity** (the `SlicingFlat` keystone
308	on the piece ring): if the adaptation equation `f_j` is a nonzerodivisor in every
309	residue-field fibre `Γ(D(h_j)) ⊗ κ(p)`, then the chart-local colength
310	`Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_j)` is flat over the Noetherian test ring. The fibrewise hypothesis is
311	the seed's `fibre_regular` clause transported through `eqn_rel` (the I-0203 open
312	transport item). -/
313	theorem flat_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField [IsNoetherianRing R]
314	    (j : A.index)
315	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
316	      (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
317	          Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
318	        nonZeroDivisors
319	          (Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
320	    Module.Flat R (A.colength j) := by
321	  haveI : Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) :=
322	    A.toFinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces j
323	  exact Module.Flat.quotient_span_singleton_of_forall_tmul_residueField hfib
324	
325	/-- **The certificate clause (c1) for the piece `j`**: fibrewise-regular equation +
326	finite colength (the support-tube finiteness input) ⟹ the colength is finite
327	projective over the Noetherian test ring — `IsCertified.finite_colength` and
328	`IsCertified.projective_colength` at `j`. -/
329	theorem projective_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField [IsNoetherianRing R]
330	    (j : A.index)
331	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
332	      (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
333	          Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
334	        nonZeroDivisors
335	          (Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
336	    [Module.Finite R (A.colength j)] :
337	    Module.Projective R (A.colength j) := by
338	  haveI : Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) :=
339	    A.toFinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces j
340	  exact Module.Projective.quotient_span_singleton_of_forall_tmul_residueField hfib
341	
342	end Junction
343	
344	end DivisorAdaptation

10	/-!
11	# The support tube in `Away`-chart form
12	
13	The pointwise certificate gate (`DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean`) asks, at each base prime
14	`p`, for an element `r ∉ p` such that the pulled system is certified over
15	`Localization.Away r`.  The support tube (`Scheme.LocalEquations.exists_supportTube`)
16	delivers piece isolation over an *abstract* Zariski neighbourhood `V` of `p`.  This file
17	refines that neighbourhood to a basic open — the shape `Localization.Away` needs — and
18	records the resulting statement.
19	
20	The refinement is the standard fact that basic opens form a topological basis of
21	`Spec R` (`PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens`); the content is only that the tube's
22	conclusion is monotone in the neighbourhood, so shrinking `V` to a basic open inside it
23	preserves support isolation.
24	
25	## Main declarations
26	
27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.exists_basicOpen_supportTube` — the tube with a
28	  basic-open neighbourhood: an `r ∉ p` whose basic open isolates the support inside `U`.
29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_notMem_supportLocus_subset_of_fibre` — the same for the
30	  relative curve over a test ring, with the properness licence supplied.
31	-/
32	
33	set_option autoImplicit false
34	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
35	
36	universe u
37	
38	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
39	
40	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
41	
42	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
43	
44	namespace Scheme.LocalEquations
45	
46	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (d : X.LocalEquations)
47	
48	/-- **The support tube with a basic-open neighbourhood.** If the support fibre over a base
49	prime `p` lies inside an open `U`, then some `r ∉ p` has its whole basic-open preimage's
50	support inside `U`.
51	
52	The tube produces an abstract neighbourhood; basic opens are a basis of `Spec R`
53	(`PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens`), so shrinking to a basic open inside it keeps the
54	conclusion by monotonicity of the preimage. This is the form the `Localization.Away`
55	charts of `IsLocallyCertified` consume. -/
56	theorem exists_basicOpen_supportTube (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
57	    [UniversallyClosed f] {U : Set X} (hU : IsOpen U) {p : PrimeSpectrum R}
58	    (hfib : f.base ⁻¹' {(p : Spec (CommRingCat.of R))} ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ U) :
59	    ∃ r : R, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
60	      f.base ⁻¹' (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
61	        ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ U := by
62	  obtain ⟨V, hpV, hV⟩ := d.exists_supportTube f hU hfib
63	  -- refine `V` to a basic open around `p`
64	  obtain ⟨W, hWmem, hpW, hWV⟩ :=
65	    PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
66	      (a := p) hpV V.isOpen
67	  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hWmem
68	  exact ⟨r, (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen r p).mp hpW,
69	    fun x hx => hV ⟨hWV hx.1, hx.2⟩⟩
70	
71	end Scheme.LocalEquations

73	/-! ## The relative-curve form -/
74	
75	section RelCurve
76	
77	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
78	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
79	
80	/-- **The relative-curve support tube, basic-open form.** For a local-equation system on
81	the relative curve over a test ring, fibrewise containment of the support in an open `U`
82	at a prime `p` gives an `r ∉ p` isolating the support over the basic open of `r`.
83	
84	The properness licence is `instIsProperRelCurveHom`; `UniversallyClosed` fires by
85	resolution. -/
86	theorem exists_notMem_supportLocus_subset_of_fibre
87	    (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) {U : Set (relCurve C R)} (hU : IsOpen U)
88	    {p : PrimeSpectrum R}
89	    (hfib : ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹'
90	        {(p : Spec (CommRingCat.of R))} ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ U) :
91	    ∃ r : R, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
92	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹'
93	          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
94	        ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ U :=
95	  d.exists_basicOpen_supportTube _ hU hfib
96	
97	end RelCurve

99	/-! ## No-leak over a shrunken base, from one fibre
100	
101	The point of the tube in the certificate lane: the no-leak hypothesis that is false
102	globally becomes *true over the tube*, because the support over the tube is already inside
103	the piece — so its closure is too, and the fibre clause holds for every base point of the
104	tube rather than only the one it was checked at. -/
105	
106	section NoLeakOverTube
107	
108	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom]
109	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
110	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
111	variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
112	
113	namespace DivisorAdaptation
114	
115	variable (A : DivisorAdaptation C R pi d)
116	
117	omit [IsProper C.hom]
118	
119	/-- **Support containment upgrades to the fibrewise no-leak clause.** If the whole family
120	support lies in the piece `j`, then over every base point the fibre of the *closure* of the
121	piece trace stays in the piece: the trace is then all of the support, which is closed.
122	
123	This is the bridge between what the tube delivers (support containment over a shrunken
124	base) and what the certificate assembler consumes (the fibrewise clause of
125	`finite_colength_of_forall_fibre_closure_subset`). -/
126	theorem forall_fibre_closure_subset_of_supportLocus_subset (j : A.index)
127	    (hsub : d.supportLocus ⊆ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) :
128	    ∀ s : Spec (CommRingCat.of R),
129	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s}
130	          ∩ closure (d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
131	        ⊆ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)) := by
132	  intro s x hx
133	  have htrace : d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)) = d.supportLocus :=
134	    Set.inter_eq_left.mpr hsub
135	  rw [htrace, d.isClosed_supportLocus.closure_eq] at hx
136	  exact hsub hx.2
137	
138	/-- The no-leak clause for **every** piece, from containment of the support in each: the
139	exact `hnoLeak` input of the certificate assemblers
140	(`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning`,
141	`ThetaGeneratorSeed.divisorAdaptation_isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning`). -/
142	theorem forall_noLeak_of_forall_supportLocus_subset
143	    (hsub : ∀ j : A.index, d.supportLocus ⊆ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) :
144	    ∀ (j : A.index) (s : Spec (CommRingCat.of R)),
145	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s}
146	          ∩ closure (d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
147	        ⊆ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)) :=
148	  fun j => A.forall_fibre_closure_subset_of_supportLocus_subset j (hsub j)
149	
150	end DivisorAdaptation
151	
152	end NoLeakOverTube
153	
154	/-! ## The tube-fibre reduction
155	
156	Combining the two halves: to obtain the certificate assembler's `hnoLeak` input over an
157	`Away` chart, it is enough to check at ONE base prime that the support fibre lies in an
158	open — the tube spreads it to a basic-open neighbourhood, and containment there upgrades to
159	the fibrewise clause. This is the precise statement the remaining geometric work has to
160	feed, and it mentions only a single fibre. -/
161	
162	section TubeFibre
163	
164	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
165	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
166	
167	/-- **The tube-fibre reduction.** If at a base prime `p` the support fibre of the system
168	lies inside an open `U`, then some `r ∉ p` has the entire support over `D(r)` inside `U`.
169	
170	Stated so that the remaining certificate obligation is *purely fibrewise*: check one fibre,
171	get a Zariski chart.  The consumer chain is
172	`exists_notMem_supportLocus_subset_of_fibre` → the pulled system's support over `D(r)` →
173	`DivisorAdaptation.forall_noLeak_of_forall_supportLocus_subset` → the assembler's
174	`hnoLeak`, and then `isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_certified_adaptation`
175	consumes the resulting away-certificate. -/
176	theorem exists_away_supportLocus_subset_of_fibre_subset
177	    (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (U : (relCurve C R).Opens) {p : PrimeSpectrum R}
178	    (hfib : ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹'
179	        {(p : Spec (CommRingCat.of R))} ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ (U : Set (relCurve C R))) :
180	    ∃ r : R, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
181	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹'
182	          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) ∩ d.supportLocus
183	        ⊆ (U : Set (relCurve C R)) :=
184	  exists_notMem_supportLocus_subset_of_fibre C R d U.isOpen hfib
185	
186	end TubeFibre
187	
188	end AlgebraicGeometry

/-- Structure extensionality for local-equation systems: the two `Prop` fields are
proof-irrelevant, so a system is determined by its cover and equations. -/
private lemma ext_eqn {d e : X.LocalEquations} (hcov : d.cover = e.cover)
    (heqn : d.eqn ≍ e.eqn) : d = e := by
  cases d; cases e
  cases hcov; cases heqn
  rfl

/-- **Divisor equality preserves the Picard class** (`𝒪(D)` depends only on the divisor):
restrict both systems to the common refinement (`picClass_restrict`), where they differ
by a unit rescaling (`picClass_rescale`). -/
theorem picClass_eq_of_divEq {d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations} (h : DivEq d₁ d₂) :
    d₁.picClass = d₂.picClass := by
  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
  rw [← d₁.picClass_restrict 𝒲 h₁, ← d₂.picClass_restrict 𝒲 h₂]
  have hres : d₁.restrict 𝒲 h₁ = (d₂.restrict 𝒲 h₂).rescale (fun x => (H x).choose) := by
    refine ext_eqn rfl (heq_of_eq (funext fun x => ?_))
    exact (H x).choose_spec
  rw [hres, picClass_rescale]

end Scheme.LocalEquations

/-! ## The finite chart adaptation -/

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k)

/-- **The `Fin`-indexed basic-open cover data** of the two pinned charts of the relative
curve (`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §1a): `m₀ + m₁` basic-open generators with partition
witnesses. The DAT-1 datum `BasicOpenCoverData` carries `Type u` index fields and hence
lives in `Type (u+1)`; this `Fin`-indexed form is the `Type u` carrier a functor value
can quotient. -/
structure FinCoverData [IsAffineHom π] : Type u where
  /-- The number of chart-0 pieces. -/
  m₀ : ℕ
  /-- The number of chart-1 pieces. -/
  m₁ : ℕ
  /-- The chart-0 basic-open generators. -/
  h₀ : Fin m₀ → Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
  /-- The chart-1 basic-open generators. -/
  h₁ : Fin m₁ → Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
  /-- The chart-0 partition coefficients. -/
  a₀ : Fin m₀ → Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
  /-- The chart-1 partition coefficients. -/
  a₁ : Fin m₁ → Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
  /-- The chart-0 partition witness. -/
  partition₀ : ∑ j : Fin m₀, a₀ j * h₀ j = 1
  /-- The chart-1 partition witness. -/
  partition₁ : ∑ j : Fin m₁, a₁ j * h₁ j = 1

namespace FinCoverData

variable {C R π} [IsAffineHom π] (D : FinCoverData C R π)

/-- The gluing index of the adaptation, `Fin m₀ ⊕ Fin m₁`. -/
abbrev index : Type := Fin D.m₀ ⊕ Fin D.m₁

/-- The pieces: the basic opens `D(h_j)` of the two pinned charts. -/
noncomputable def pieces : D.index → (relCurve C R).Opens :=
  Sum.elim (fun j => (relCurve C R).basicOpen (D.h₀ j))
    (fun j => (relCurve C R).basicOpen (D.h₁ j))

@[simp]
lemma pieces_inl (j : Fin D.m₀) :
    D.pieces (Sum.inl j) = (relCurve C R).basicOpen (D.h₀ j) := rfl

@[simp]
lemma pieces_inr (j : Fin D.m₁) :
    D.pieces (Sum.inr j) = (relCurve C R).basicOpen (D.h₁ j) := rfl

/-- The chart-0 pieces cover the pinned chart `V₀ᴿ`. -/
lemma cover₀ : (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ≤
    ⨆ j : Fin D.m₀, (relCurve C R).basicOpen (D.h₀ j) :=
  le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one D.a₀ D.h₀ D.partition₀

/-- The chart-1 pieces cover the pinned chart `V₁ᴿ`. -/
lemma cover₁ : (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤
    ⨆ j : Fin D.m₁, (relCurve C R).basicOpen (D.h₁ j) :=
  le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one D.a₁ D.h₁ D.partition₁

end FinCoverData

/-- Restriction of sections of the relative curve as an `R`-algebra homomorphism
(`Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra` structures on both sides). -/
noncomputable def relResAlgHom {W V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (h : W ≤ V) :
    Γ(relCurve C R, V) →ₐ[R] Γ(relCurve C R, W) :=
  AlgHom.mk' (CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op))
    (fun c x => by
      simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
      rw [map_mul]
      congr 1
      rw [Scheme.algebraMap_overSectionsAlgebra, Scheme.algebraMap_overSectionsAlgebra]
      exact (relCurve C R).overAlgebraMap_apply_res R (homOfLE h).op c)

@[simp]
lemma relResAlgHom_apply {W V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
    relResAlgHom C R h s = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s :=
  rfl

/-- **The finite chart adaptation of a local-equation system** (worksheet §1.1 (D1)):
basic-open cover data of the two pinned charts, equations `f_j` on the pieces, and the
pointwise refinement clause `eqn_rel` — on the overlap of each piece with any member of
`d.cover`, `f_j` agrees with `d`'s equation up to a unit. Regularity of the `f_j` is
DERIVED (`DivisorAdaptation.eqn_regular`), not stored. -/
structure DivisorAdaptation [IsAffineHom π] (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) :
    Type u extends FinCoverData C R π where
  /-- The equation on the piece `D(h_j)`. -/
  eqn : ∀ j : toFinCoverData.index, Γ(relCurve C R, toFinCoverData.pieces j)
  /-- The equations refine `d` pointwise up to units: on the overlap of each piece with
  any member of `d`'s cover, `f_j` and `d`'s equation differ by a unit. Point-free (the
  `DivEq` spelling), so it pulls back along arbitrary morphisms — the resolution of the
  DD-1 pt-transport seam (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §1a). The quantifier ranges over ALL
  `y`: the empty overlap carries the zero ring, where the clause is trivial. -/
  eqn_rel : ∀ (j : toFinCoverData.index) (y : relCurve C R),
    ∃ u : Γ(relCurve C R, toFinCoverData.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens y)ˣ,
      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op).hom (eqn j)
        = (u : Γ(relCurve C R, toFinCoverData.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens y))
          * ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op).hom (d.eqn y)

namespace DivisorAdaptation

variable {C R π} [IsAffineHom π] {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
variable (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)

/-- **The compatibility constructor from anchored refinement data** (the pre-DD-2 field
layout): a base point `pt j` of `d.cover` per piece with `pieces j ≤ d.cover.opens (pt j)`
and a comparison unit `eqn j = unit j · res (d.eqn (pt j))`. The pointwise clause
`eqn_rel` is derived by rewriting `d.eqn (pt j)` into `d.eqn y` through the transition
unit `d.ratioUnit (pt j) y` on the overlap (the `DivEq.trans` calc pattern). -/
def ofAnchors (D : FinCoverData C R π)
    (eqn : ∀ j : D.index, Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j))
    (pt : D.index → relCurve C R)
    (piece_le : ∀ j, D.pieces j ≤ d.cover.opens (pt j))
    (unit : ∀ j, Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)ˣ)
    (eqn_eq : ∀ j, eqn j = (unit j : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j))
      * ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE (piece_le j)).op).hom (d.eqn (pt j))) :
    DivisorAdaptation C R π d where
  toFinCoverData := D
  eqn := eqn
  eqn_rel := fun j y => by
    have hWle : D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens y
        ≤ d.cover.opens (pt j) ⊓ d.cover.opens y :=
      inf_le_inf (piece_le j) le_rfl
    have E1 := congrArg ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE
      (inf_le_left : D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens y ≤ D.pieces j)).op).hom (eqn_eq j)
    rw [map_mul, Scheme.LocalEquations.res_res] at E1
    have E2 := congrArg ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWle).op).hom
      (d.eqn_restrict_eq (pt j) y)
    rw [map_mul, Scheme.LocalEquations.res_res, Scheme.LocalEquations.res_res] at E2
    refine ⟨(relCurve C R).unitsRestrict inf_le_left (unit j)
      * (relCurve C R).unitsRestrict hWle (d.ratioUnit (pt j) y), ?_⟩
    rw [Units.val_mul]
    calc ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op).hom (eqn j)
        = ((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict inf_le_left (unit j)).val
          * ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE
              ((inf_le_left : D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens y ≤ D.pieces j).trans
                (piece_le j))).op).hom (d.eqn (pt j)) := by
          rw [show ((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
              D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens y ≤ D.pieces j) (unit j)).val
              = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
                  D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens y ≤ D.pieces j)).op).hom (unit j).val
            from rfl]
          exact E1
      _ = ((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict inf_le_left (unit j)).val
          * (((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict hWle (d.ratioUnit (pt j) y)).val
            * ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hWle.trans
                (inf_le_right : d.cover.opens (pt j) ⊓ d.cover.opens y
                  ≤ d.cover.opens y))).op).hom (d.eqn y)) := by
          rw [show ((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict hWle (d.ratioUnit (pt j) y)).val
              = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map
                  (homOfLE hWle).op).hom (d.ratioUnit (pt j) y).val from rfl]
          rw [E2]
      _ = ((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict inf_le_left (unit j)).val
          * ((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict hWle (d.ratioUnit (pt j) y)).val
          * ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE
              (inf_le_right : D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens y
                ≤ d.cover.opens y)).op).hom (d.eqn y) := by
          rw [mul_assoc]

/-- The adaptation's equations are regular: at `z ∈ D(h_j)` the pointwise clause
`eqn_rel j z` presents the germ of `f_j` as a unit germ times the germ of `d`'s regular
equation at the member of `z` itself. -/
theorem eqn_regular (j : A.index) (z : relCurve C R) (hz : z ∈ A.pieces j) :
    ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j) z hz).hom (A.eqn j)
      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R).presheaf.stalk z) := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := A.eqn_rel j z
  have hzW : z ∈ A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens z := ⟨hz, d.cover.mem_opens z⟩
  have hgerm : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j) z hz).hom (A.eqn j)
      = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens z) z hzW).hom
          (u : Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens z))
        * ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens z) z
            (d.cover.mem_opens z)).hom (d.eqn z) := by
    have h := congrArg ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
      (A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens z) z hzW).hom hu
    rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at h
    exact h
  rw [hgerm]
  exact mul_mem
    ((u.isUnit.map ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
      (A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens z) z hzW).hom).mem_nonZeroDivisors)
    (d.regular z z (d.cover.mem_opens z))

/-! ### The colength modules and the glued equalizer -/

/-- The chart-local colength module `Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_j)`, an `R`-algebra through
`Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra`. -/
noncomputable abbrev colength (j : A.index) : Type u :=
  Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⧸ Ideal.span {A.eqn j}

/-- The symmetric overlap ideal: both equations restricted to the piece overlap. The
two restrictions generate the same ideal (the equations differ by units on overlaps
through the refinement witness), but the symmetric span needs no transport in the
DEFINITION. -/

9	/-!
10	# Finite-adaptation extraction: every local-equation system has a chart adaptation
11	(`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (d))
12	
13	Every `LocalEquations` system `d` on the relative curve `C_R = relCurve C R` refines to a
14	finite chart adaptation `DivisorAdaptation C R π d` (`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §1a): the two
15	pinned charts `V₀ᴿ`, `V₁ᴿ` are affine, so the DAT-1 (1f) affine-refinement engine
16	(`IsAffineOpen.exists_finite_basicOpen_refinement` in
17	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafExtraction`)
18	produces, for each chart, a finite basic-open family subordinated to `d.cover` at anchor
19	points, with a partition of unity. Reindexing each chart family through `Fintype.equivFin`
20	gives the `Fin`-indexed `FinCoverData`; the equations are the restrictions of `d`'s
21	equations at the anchors (comparison unit `1`), regular by `d.regular` through the
22	refinement subordination.
23	
24	The **certificate** (`DivisorAdaptation.IsCertified`) is deliberately NOT part of the
25	extraction: an adaptation always exists, whereas the colength certificate is an extra
26	finiteness/flatness hypothesis on `d` (the object of DD-1c's field dictionary and DAT-B's
27	coverage step, which supply it separately).
28	
29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_divisorAdaptation` — the extraction: `Nonempty
30	  (DivisorAdaptation C R π d)` for every `d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations`.
31	-/

47	/-- **Finite-adaptation extraction** (`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (d), the DAT-1 (1f)
48	pattern): every local-equation system on the relative curve refines to a finite chart
49	adaptation. The two pinned charts are affine, so on each the affine-refinement engine
50	produces a finite basic-open family subordinated to `d.cover` at anchor points with a
51	partition of unity; the equations are the anchor equations of `d` restricted to the pieces
52	(comparison unit `1`), regular through the subordination. The colength certificate is a
53	separate hypothesis and is not produced here. -/
54	theorem exists_divisorAdaptation (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) :
55	    Nonempty (DivisorAdaptation C R π d) := by
56	  classical
57	  obtain ⟨ι₀, _, f₀, an₀, b₀, hsub₀, hpart₀⟩ :=
58	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).exists_finite_basicOpen_refinement d.cover
59	  obtain ⟨ι₁, _, f₁, an₁, b₁, hsub₁, hpart₁⟩ :=
60	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).exists_finite_basicOpen_refinement d.cover
61	  set e₀ : Fin (Fintype.card ι₀) ≃ ι₀ := (Fintype.equivFin ι₀).symm with he₀
62	  set e₁ : Fin (Fintype.card ι₁) ≃ ι₁ := (Fintype.equivFin ι₁).symm with he₁
63	  -- the `Fin`-indexed cover data
64	  set D : FinCoverData C R π :=
65	    { m₀ := Fintype.card ι₀
66	      m₁ := Fintype.card ι₁
67	      h₀ := fun j => f₀ (e₀ j)
68	      h₁ := fun j => f₁ (e₁ j)
69	      a₀ := fun j => b₀ (e₀ j)
70	      a₁ := fun j => b₁ (e₁ j)
71	      partition₀ := (Equiv.sum_comp e₀ (fun i => b₀ i * f₀ i)).trans hpart₀
72	      partition₁ := (Equiv.sum_comp e₁ (fun i => b₁ i * f₁ i)).trans hpart₁ } with hD
73	  -- the anchor of each piece and its subordination to a member of `d.cover`
74	  set pt : D.index → relCurve C R :=
75	    Sum.elim (fun j => an₀ (e₀ j)) (fun j => an₁ (e₁ j)) with hpt
76	  have hle : ∀ j : D.index, D.pieces j ≤ d.cover.opens (pt j) := by
77	    rintro (j | j)
78	    · exact hsub₀ (e₀ j)
79	    · exact hsub₁ (e₁ j)
80	  exact ⟨DivisorAdaptation.ofAnchors D
81	    (fun j => ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hle j)).op).hom (d.eqn (pt j)))
82	    pt hle (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => by rw [Units.val_one, one_mul])⟩
83

/-! ## The affine basic-open refinement of a pointed cover -/

/-- **Affine refinement of a pointed cover with a partition of unity**: on an affine
open `V`, any pointed cover `𝒰` refines to a finite family of basic opens `D(f i)`,
each contained in the cover member at an anchor point, whose sections admit a partition
of unity `∑ a i · f i = 1` in `Γ(X, V)`. -/
theorem IsAffineOpen.exists_finite_basicOpen_refinement {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : X.Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (f : ι → Γ(X, V)) (anchor : ι → X)
      (a : ι → Γ(X, V)),
      (∀ i : ι, X.basicOpen (f i) ≤ 𝒰.opens (anchor i)) ∧ ∑ i : ι, a i * f i = 1 := by
  classical
  -- a basic open through every point of `V`, inside the cover member at that point
  have hpt : ∀ p : ↥V, ∃ f : Γ(X, V),
      X.basicOpen f ≤ 𝒰.opens (p : X) ⊓ V ∧ (p : X) ∈ X.basicOpen f := fun p =>
    hV.exists_basicOpen_le (V := 𝒰.opens (p : X) ⊓ V)
      (⟨(p : X), ⟨𝒰.mem_opens (p : X), p.2⟩⟩ : ↥(𝒰.opens (p : X) ⊓ V)) p.2
  choose f hfle hfmem using hpt
  -- a finite subfamily covering the quasi-compact `V`
  have hcov : (V : Set X) ⊆ ⋃ p : ↥V, (X.basicOpen (f p) : Set X) := fun q hq =>
    Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, hfmem ⟨q, hq⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hV.isCompact.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun p : ↥V => (X.basicOpen (f p) : Set X))
    (fun p => (X.basicOpen (f p)).isOpen) hcov
  -- the finite subfamily, reindexed over the subcover
  have hle : V ≤ ⨆ x : (Set.range fun i : {p : ↥V // p ∈ t} => f (i : ↥V) :
      Set Γ(X, V)), X.basicOpen (x : Γ(X, V)) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨p, hpt', hpq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht hq)
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
      ⟨⟨f p, Set.mem_range_self (⟨p, hpt'⟩ : {p : ↥V // p ∈ t})⟩, hpq⟩
  have hspan : Ideal.span
      (Set.range fun i : {p : ↥V // p ∈ t} => f (i : ↥V)) = ⊤ :=
    hV.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff.mp hle
  have hone : (1 : Γ(X, V)) ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i : {p : ↥V // p ∈ t} => f (i : ↥V)) :=
    (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mp hspan
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hone
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hone
  exact ⟨{p : ↥V // p ∈ t}, inferInstance, fun i => f (i : ↥V),
    fun i => ((i : ↥V) : X), a, fun i => (hfle (i : ↥V)).trans inf_le_left, ha⟩

/-- **The local-equation system of a theta generator seed** (the DDR-3 family): the
pieces are the pointed cover, the equations are the side components of the chosen
generators; regularity is the germ-regularity law, the overlap units are the ratio
law. -/

    (relCurve C R).LocalEquations where

  eqn := D.eqn

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeCertZarSeed

/-!
# From pointwise away-certificates to a span-`⊤` family

`DivSchemeCertZarSeed.lean` reduced the DD-R certificate gate to *away-local* certificates
over a span-`⊤` family.  The geometry that produces such certificates, however, is
pointwise on the base: the support tube (`Scheme.LocalEquations.exists_supportTube`)
isolates the pieces over a Zariski neighbourhood **of one base point at a time**, and the
fibre analyses all read at a single `p : PrimeSpectrum R`.

This file closes that gap with the quasi-compactness step.  If for every prime `p` there
is some `r ∉ p` over whose away localization the system is certified, then the good
elements span the unit ideal (their basic opens cover `Spec R`), so finitely many of them
already do — and `isLocallyCertified_of_forall_exists_away` applies.

The result is that the certificate gate for the DD-R endgame is now genuinely *pointwise*:
one base point at a time, exactly the shape the landed fibre machinery delivers.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_away` — the pointwise gate
  for a bare local-equation system.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.ThetaGeneratorSeed.isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_away_certified`
  — the seed form.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

/-! ## The quasi-compactness step -/

section SpanTop

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

/-- **Pointwise good elements span the unit ideal, finitely.** If a predicate `P` on `R`
holds at some element outside each prime, then finitely many elements satisfying `P` span
`⊤`.  This is quasi-compactness of `Spec R` in the elementary form the certificate gate
needs: the basic opens of the good elements cover the spectrum, hence the good set spans
the unit ideal, hence `1` is a finite combination of good elements. -/
theorem exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime (P : R → Prop)
    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ P r) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ i, P (g i) := by
  classical
  -- the good elements span the unit ideal, because their basic opens cover `Spec R`
  have hspan : Ideal.span {r : R | P r} = ⊤ := by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff']
    refine top_le_iff.mp fun p _ => ?_
    obtain ⟨r, hrp, hrP⟩ := h p
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨r, by
      simpa only [Opens.mem_iSup, PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen] using ⟨hrP, hrp⟩⟩
  -- `1` is then a finite combination of good elements
  have hone : (1 : R) ∈ Submodule.span R {r : R | P r} := by
    show (1 : R) ∈ Ideal.span {r : R | P r}
    rw [hspan]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨T, hTsub, hT⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span hone
  refine ⟨T.card, fun i => (T.equivFin.symm i : R), ?_, fun i => hTsub (T.equivFin.symm i).2⟩
  have hrange : Set.range (fun i : Fin T.card => ((T.equivFin.symm i : R))) = (T : Set R) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact (T.equivFin.symm i).2
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨T.equivFin ⟨x, hx⟩, by simp⟩
  rw [hrange]
  exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hT isUnit_one

end SpanTop

/-! ## The pointwise certificate gate -/

section Pointwise

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]

/-- **The pointwise certificate gate.** If over every prime of the base there is an away
localization carrying a certified family divisor-equal to the pulled system, the system is
locally certified.  Combines the quasi-compactness step with the span-`⊤` production rule
`isLocallyCertified_of_forall_exists_away`. -/
theorem isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_away {n : ℕ}
    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away r) pi n,
        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) d))) :
    IsLocallyCertified C R pi n d := by
  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hgood⟩ := exists_fin_span_eq_top_of_forall_prime
    (fun r =>
      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away r) pi n,
        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) d))) h
  exact isLocallyCertified_of_forall_exists_away g hg hgood

end Pointwise

namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
variable {a n : ℕ} {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R pi a)}
variable {D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R pi a K}

omit [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

/-- **The pointwise certificate gate for a seed.** One base point at a time: an away
localization at each prime carrying a certified family divisor-equal to the pulled seed
system makes the seed's system locally certified, hence a `DivFamZar` class.

This is the shape the landed geometry actually produces — the support tube isolates pieces
over a neighbourhood of one base point, and every fibre analysis reads at a single prime —
so no globally valid no-leak hypothesis (false in general, I-0209) is required anywhere. -/
theorem isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_away_certified (hD : D.IsGenerator)
    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away r) pi n,
        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
          ((D.localEquations hD).pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) (D.localEquations hD)))) :
    IsLocallyCertified C R pi n (D.localEquations hD) :=
  isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_away h

/-- **The gate in its most consumable form: certify the pulled system after shrinking.**
At every prime it suffices to produce an `r ∉ p` and a certificate for *some* adaptation
of the pulled seed system over `Localization.Away r`.  The adaptation itself is free
(`exists_divisorAdaptation`), so the only genuine obligation is the certificate over the
shrunken base — where the support tube makes per-piece isolation available.

Contrast with the old gate `divisorAdaptation_isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning`,
which demanded a certificate for the *canonically extracted* adaptation over the whole
chart ring; that shape forces a globally valid no-leak hypothesis, which is false. -/
theorem isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_certified_adaptation
    (hD : D.IsGenerator)
    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
      ∃ A : DivisorAdaptation C (Localization.Away r) pi
          ((D.localEquations hD).pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) (D.localEquations hD))),
        A.IsCertified n) :
    IsLocallyCertified C R pi n (D.localEquations hD) := by
  refine isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_away_certified hD fun p => ?_
  obtain ⟨r, hrp, A, hA⟩ := h p
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
  -- bundle the supplied adaptation and its certificate; the divisor equality is `rfl`
  exact ⟨r, hrp, ⟨_, A, hA⟩, Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl _⟩

/-- The `DivFamZar` class of a seed certified pointwise on the base. -/
noncomputable def divFamZar_of_forall_prime_away_certified (hD : D.IsGenerator)
    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away r) pi n,
        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
          ((D.localEquations hD).pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) (D.localEquations hD)))) :
    DivFamZar C R pi n :=
  DivFamZar.mk (D.localEquations hD)
    (isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_away_certified hD h)

end ThetaGeneratorSeed

end AlgebraicGeometry

/-!
# DAT-B B-3 — the `hsurj` completion and the field DivScheme-point

The field-dictionary completion of the DAT-B worksheet
(`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.7, COV-4): over a field `K`, every effective
degree-`n` Weil divisor on the relative curve is the divisor of a certified divisor
family (`exists_divFam_divFamDivisor_eq`, the `hsurj` slot of
`divFamFieldEquivOfDegOfSurj`), so the field dictionary closes unconditionally
(`divFamFieldEquiv`), and — through the landed F4 layer (`divRepClassifyZar`,
I-0243) — every effective degree-`g` divisor yields a `DivScheme`-point
`overSpec k K ⟶ divSchemeOver!` (`effectiveDivisorClassifyZar`), the worksheet §3.3
effectivity export DAT-J's quasi-compactness image argument consumes.

## Route, and the recorded deviation from the worksheet pin

* The anchor equations come from the landed backward realization
  `exists_localEquations_presentationDivisor_eq` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyBackward.lean`):
  a product of tracked point-uniformizer equations cutting exactly `D`.
* **Deviation (worksheet §1.7 / risk 5, superseded by I-0230):** the worksheet routes
  the certificate through a *support-separated* adaptation and
  `deg_divFamDivisor_of_separated`.  The landed CRT layer
  (`DivisorAdaptation.deg_presentationDivisor`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyFieldCRT.lean`,
  I-0230) computes `deg K (div d) = finrank K W(d)` for **every** adaptation with no
  separation hypothesis — and full support-separation is in fact unachievable when a
  support point lies in the overlap of the two pinned charts (each chart's partition
  forces its pieces to cover the whole chart, so such a point lies in one piece of
  *each* chart).  The certificate is therefore discharged on the plain extraction
  adaptation (`exists_divisorAdaptation`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyExtraction.lean`):
  over the field every module is free — (c1)-projective, (c3), (c4) are instances —
  (c1)-finiteness is the chart colength reading
  (`moduleFinite_quotient_span_section`, empty pieces are subsingleton), and the
  (c2) rank is the CRT degree identity against `deg K D = n`
  (`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_of_deg`).
* The DivScheme-point corollary consumes `DivFam.toZar` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyZar.lean`)
  and the landed `divRepClassifyZar` (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZar.lean`) verbatim.
-/

theorem exists_divFam_divFamDivisor_eq (D : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor)

/-!
# The moving lemma: pieces on which the class trivializes ((C2) effectivity, brick E4)

**Piece selection** for the (C2) effectivity splice: for a *module-finite* faithfully
flat cover `A → B`, every point `x` of the base curve `X_A` admits an affine open
`V ∋ x` such that any prescribed Čech Picard class `L` on `X_B` restricts trivially to
the open subscheme `cg⁻¹ V` of the cover curve.

The route is pure commutative algebra — no integrality of the curve, no divisors:

* the class of `L` on a `cg`-saturated affine piece `O₀ = cg⁻¹ V₀ ∋ cg⁻¹(x)` is an
  invertible module `N` over `Γ(X_B, O₀)` (`Scheme.Opens.cechPicClass`, the affine
  dictionary `toPic` conjugated by `topIso`);
* the fiber of `Spec Γ(O₀) → Spec Γ(V₀)` over the germ prime of `x` is **finite** —
  the piece ring is module-finite over the base piece by E0's identification
  `Γ(O₀) ≅ Γ(V₀) ⊗[A] B` and `[Module.Finite A B]`, so the algebra is quasi-finite
  (`Algebra.QuasiFinite.finite_comap_preimage_singleton`);
* the **avoidance brick** (`Module.Invertible.exists_notMem_isUnit_free`) produces
  `f ∈ Γ(O₀)` avoiding every fiber prime with `N` free wherever `f` is inverted;
* the **algebraic tube** (`Algebra.exists_notMem_algebraMap_eq_mul`, going-up for the
  module-finite piece map) produces `g ∉ p_x` with `cg^♯ g = f · h`, so
  `V := X_A.basicOpen g ∋ x` has `cg⁻¹ V = X_B.basicOpen (cg^♯ g) ≤ X_B.basicOpen f`;
* freeness of `N` over `Γ(X_B, X_B.basicOpen f)` (where `f` restricts to a unit) makes
  the class trivial there (`Scheme.Opens.cechPicClass_basicOpen_eq_one_of_free`), and
  restriction triviality is monotone (`Scheme.cechPicMap_ι_eq_one_of_le`).

The conversion of this class-level triviality into the trimmed trivializing cochain
(`Over.PieceTrivialization`) that the landed per-piece descent consumes is
`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.EffectivityTrivialization`.

## Why module-finiteness

For a merely étale (quasi-finite, non-finite) cover the statement is **false**: the
bare restricted class need not trivialize on any saturated neighbourhood of a fiber
(e.g. `B = A_u × A_v` over a two-dimensional normal local `A` with nontrivial local
class group).  The general-cover effectivity therefore genuinely needs the descent
data, and is reached in the close through covers refined to module-finite ones (over a
field test every étale cover is refined by a finite separable field extension).
-/

import Mathlib.RingTheory.PicardGroup
import Mathlib.RingTheory.QuasiFinite.Basic
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Ideal
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.GoingUp

/-!
# Trivializing an invertible module away from finitely many primes ((C2), brick E4)

The pure-algebra core of the (C2) piece-selection moving lemma: an invertible module
over a commutative ring becomes **free** after inverting a single element avoiding any
prescribed finite set of primes; and, for a finite (integral) algebra, an element of the
extension avoiding every prime over a base prime `p` divides the image of an element of
the base avoiding `p` — the **algebraic tube**.

* `Module.Invertible.free_of_span_singleton_eq_top` — a cyclic invertible module is
  free: the section `r ↦ r • m₀` is injective because a dual functional pairs `m₀` to a
  unit (surjectivity of the contraction), and surjective by cyclicity.
* `Module.Invertible.exists_notMem_isUnit_free` — **the avoidance brick**: for an
  invertible `N` over `R` and finitely many primes `q i`, there is `f ∉ ⋃ q i` such that
  `S ⊗[R] N` is free over every `R`-algebra `S` in which `f` becomes a unit.  Route:
  localize at the complement `S₀` of `⋃ q i`; the localization is semilocal (every
  maximal ideal is one of the localized `q i` by prime avoidance), so its Picard group
  is trivial (mathlib) and `LocalizedModule S₀ N` is cyclic; clearing denominators in
  the generator relations of finitely many generators of `N` produces `f`.
* `Algebra.exists_notMem_algebraMap_eq_mul` — **the algebraic tube**: for an integral
  algebra `S → R`, a prime `p` of `S`, and `f : R` avoiding every prime of `R` lying
  over `p`, some `g ∉ p` has `algebraMap S R g = f * h` — going-up
  (`Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral`) applied to the ideal `(f)`.

These feed `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.EffectivityMoving`: the primes are the finitely
many points of the fiber of the cover inclusion `cg` over a point `x` (finiteness by
quasi-finiteness of the module-finite piece rings), and the tube converts the basic
open `D(f)` of the cover piece into the preimage of a basic open `D(g) ∋ x` downstairs.
-/

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeCertSeed
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg

/-!
# Zariski-local certification of a seed system: relaxing the global certificate gate

The DD-R endgame consumes divisor families through `DivFamZar` (`DivisorFamilyZar.lean`),
whose membership predicate is `IsLocallyCertified`: some span-`⊤` family `g : Fin m → R`
carries certified families over the localizations `Localization.Away (g i)` which are
divisor-equal to the pulled system.  **Nothing downstream of `DivFamZar` asks for a
certificate over `R` itself.**

The certificate-assembly lane has nevertheless been attacking the *global* clause
`(D.divisorAdaptation hD).IsCertified g` over the chart ring `R_Z`, whose no-leak input
is exactly the hypothesis that is FALSE for arbitrary extracted pieces (I-0209: a piece
whose support trace leaks has a non-finite colength, and the localization repair breaks
finiteness over `R`).  The lane has been paying for a strictly stronger statement than
its consumer needs.

/-! ## The closed-trace topology: no leak ⟹ closed -/

/-- **The closed-trace from an empty leak**: the trace `V \ D(g)` of the vanishing locus of
a section `g` on an open `V` is closed in the whole scheme as soon as its closure stays
inside `V`.  (The other inclusion, `closure (V \ D(g)) ⊆ (D(g))ᶜ`, is automatic since
`V \ D(g)` already lies in the closed set `(D(g))ᶜ`.) -/
theorem isClosed_sdiff_basicOpen_of_closure_subset {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : X.Opens}
    (g : Γ(X, V))
    (hcl : closure ((V : Set X) \ (X.basicOpen g : Set X)) ⊆ (V : Set X)) :
    IsClosed ((V : Set X) \ (X.basicOpen g : Set X)) := by
  apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨hcl hx, ?_⟩
  exact closure_minimal (fun _ h => h.2) (X.basicOpen g).isOpen.isClosed_compl hx

/-- **The closed-trace from a fibrewise no-leak**: if, over every base point `s`, the part
of the closure of the trace `V \ D(g)` lying over `s` stays inside `V`, then the trace is
closed.  The fibrewise hypothesis is the topological shadow of the finite fibre support of
the divisor cut by `g` (produced Zariski-locally on the base by the properness of the
structure morphism). -/
theorem isClosed_sdiff_basicOpen_of_forall_fibre {X S : Scheme.{u}} (φ : X ⟶ S)
    {V : X.Opens} (g : Γ(X, V))
    (hfib : ∀ s : S, φ.base ⁻¹' {s} ∩ closure ((V : Set X) \ (X.basicOpen g : Set X))
      ⊆ (V : Set X)) :
    IsClosed ((V : Set X) \ (X.basicOpen g : Set X)) :=
  isClosed_sdiff_basicOpen_of_closure_subset g (fun x hx => hfib (φ.base x) ⟨rfl, hx⟩)

/-! ## The abstract engine in closure-subset spelling -/

/-- **The abstract (c1)-finiteness engine, closure-subset spelling**: for an affine open
`V` of a scheme `X` over `Spec R` with universally-closed and locally-of-finite-type
structure morphism, if the closure of `V \ D(g)` stays inside `V`, then `Γ(X, V) ⧸ (g)` is
a finite `R`-module.  A thin closure-subset wrapper over
`IsAffineOpen.finite_quotient_span_singleton_of_isClosed`; consumes no `DivisorAdaptation`
(anti-circular). -/
theorem IsAffineOpen.finite_quotient_span_singleton_of_closure_subset
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))]
    [UniversallyClosed (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))]
    (g : Γ(X, V))
    (hcl : closure ((V : Set X) \ (X.basicOpen g : Set X)) ⊆ (V : Set X)) :
    Module.Finite R (Γ(X, V) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) :=
  hV.finite_quotient_span_singleton_of_isClosed g
    (isClosed_sdiff_basicOpen_of_closure_subset g hcl)

/-- **The ambient colength finiteness `hcolFin` from an empty leak** (the `hcolFin`
hypothesis of `isGenerator_of_fibrewise_ker_span_of_field_vanishing`, reduced to the
topological closed-trace): if on every piece the closure of the trace

/-! ## Pullback along the base-change projection -/

/-- **The first projection of a base change along an affine morphism is affine**: for `X, T`
objects of `Over S`, `(fst X T).left` is (up to the defeq `Over.fst_left`/`Over.tensorObj_left`)
the pullback of `T.hom` along `X.hom`, i.e. `Limits.pullback.fst X.hom T.hom`
(`Over.isPullback_left`, flipped so that the affine leg `T.hom` lines up with the class field
`IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback`); affineness is stable under base change
(`isAffineHom_isStableUnderBaseChange`). -/
instance Over.isAffineHom_fst_left {S : Scheme.{u}} (X T : Over S) [IsAffineHom T.hom] :
    IsAffineHom (fst X T).left :=
  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsAffineHom) (Over.isPullback_left X T).flip ‹_›

/-- The underlying scheme of `overSpec k A` is affine (restated from `overSpec_left`, which
identifies it with `Spec (.of A)`, so that instance search finds it without unfolding the
`abbrev overSpec`). -/
instance isAffine_overSpec_left {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    [Algebra k A] : IsAffine (overSpec k A).left := by
  rw [overSpec_left]; infer_instance

/-- The structure morphism `overSpec k A ⟶ Spec k` is affine: it is a morphism between affine
schemes. -/
instance isAffineHom_overSpec_hom {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    [Algebra k A] : IsAffineHom (overSpec k A).hom :=
  isAffineHom_of_isAffine _

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}

/-- **Base change of an affine two-chart cover**: an affine two-chart cover `D` of `C.left`
pulls back, along the first projection `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left ⟶ C.left`, to an affine
two-chart cover of `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`, for any `k`-algebra `R`. The charts are the
preimages of `D`'s charts under the first projection. All four fields follow from `D`'s
fields: the first projection is an affine morphism (`Over.isAffineHom_fst_left`, since
`overSpec k R ⟶ Spec k` is a morphism between affine schemes hence affine), preimage of an
affine open under an affine morphism is affine, and preimage commutes with `⊔`, `⊓`, `⊤`. -/
noncomputable def Scheme.AffineTwoCover.pullbackProd (D : C.left.AffineTwoCover)
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] :
    (C ⊗ overSpec k R).left.AffineTwoCover where
  V₀ := (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ D.V₀
  V₁ := (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ D.V₁
  isAffineOpen₀ := D.isAffineOpen₀.preimage (fst C (overSpec k R)).left
  isAffineOpen₁ := D.isAffineOpen₁.preimage (fst C (overSpec k R)).left
  sup_eq_top := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_sup, D.sup_eq_top, Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]
  isAffineOpen_inf := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
    exact D.isAffineOpen_inf.preimage (fst C (overSpec k R)).left

end PullbackProd

lemma relPinnedPieceSectionsMap_eq_appLE
    (L : Type u) [CommRing L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra R L] [IsScalarTower k R L]
    (b : Bool) (g : Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R pi b))
    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen g)) :
    relPinnedPieceSectionsMap (C := C) (R := R) (pi := pi) L b g s =
      ((relCurveMap C R L).appLE
        ((relCurve C R).basicOpen g)
        ((relCurve C L).basicOpen (relPinnedSectionsMap C R L pi b g))
        (relPinnedSectionsMap_basicOpen (C := C) (R := R) (pi := pi) L b g).le).hom s := by
  cases b <;> rfl

/-- The side-uniform piece comparison carries the restriction of a pinned-chart section
to the restriction of its transported section. -/
lemma relPinnedPieceSectionsMap_algebraMap
    (L : Type u) [CommRing L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra R L] [IsScalarTower k R L]
    (b : Bool) (g s : Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R pi b)) :
    relPinnedPieceSectionsMap (C := C) (R := R) (pi := pi) L b g
        (algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R pi b)
          Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen g) s) =
      algebraMap Γ(relCurve C L, relPinnedChart C L pi b)
        Γ(relCurve C L,
          (relCurve C L).basicOpen (relPinnedSectionsMap C R L pi b g))
        (relPinnedSectionsMap C R L pi b s) := by
  cases b with
  | false => exact pieceSectionsMap_algebraMap L (fiberChart₀ pi) g s
  | true => exact pieceSectionsMap_algebraMap L (fiberChart₁ pi) g s

theorem eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors (hD : D.IsGenerator)
    (z : relCurve C R) (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    (D.eqn z ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) ∈
      nonZeroDivisors
        (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by

    (hD.fibre_regular z p (1 : Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z)))

variable [IsNoetherianRing R]

/-- Restricting the pulled seed equation to the base-changed seed piece is exactly the
side-uniform base change of the original seed equation.  This is the section-level bridge
from the pulled presentation divisor to the residue-fibre reading of the pointwise seed. -/
theorem pullbackEqn_res_self_eq_relPinnedPieceSectionsMap (hD : D.IsGenerator)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) (z : relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).resHom
        (relPinnedSectionsMap_basicOpen (C := C) (R := R) (pi := pi)
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField
          (D.side ((relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField).base z))
          (D.h ((relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField).base z))).le
        (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn
          (relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField) (D.localEquations hD) z) =
      relPinnedPieceSectionsMap (C := C) (R := R) (pi := pi)
        p.asIdeal.ResidueField
        (D.side ((relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField).base z))
        (D.h ((relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField).base z))
        (D.eqn ((relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField).base z)) := by
  let y : relCurve C R := (relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField).base z
  let hopen := relPinnedSectionsMap_basicOpen (C := C) (R := R) (pi := pi)
    p.asIdeal.ResidueField (D.side y) (D.h y)
  calc
    _ = ((relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField).appLE
          ((relCurve C R).basicOpen (D.h y))

namespace FinCoverData

variable (D : FinCoverData C R π)

/-- Every point of the relative curve lies in a piece: the pieces partition the two
pinned charts, which cover the curve. -/
lemma exists_mem_pieces (z : relCurve C R) : ∃ j : D.index, z ∈ D.pieces j := by
  have hz : z ∈ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊔ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := by
    rw [relCover_sup]
    trivial
  rcases Opens.mem_sup.mp hz with h | h
  · have hcov := D.cover₀ h
    rw [Opens.mem_iSup] at hcov
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov
    exact ⟨Sum.inl j, hj⟩
  · have hcov := D.cover₁ h
    rw [Opens.mem_iSup] at hcov
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov
    exact ⟨Sum.inr j, hj⟩

/-- The pieces are affine opens (basic opens of the affine pinned charts). -/
lemma isAffineOpen_pieces (j : D.index) : IsAffineOpen (D.pieces j) := by
  cases j
  · exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen _
  · exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen _

/-- The indexed piece-level term identification
`R' ⊗[R] Γ(D(h_j)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h'_j))` (casewise the generic
`pieceTermBaseChangeAlg` at the pinned charts). -/
noncomputable def pieceTermBaseChange :
    ∀ j : D.index, R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) ≃ₐ[R']
      Γ(relCurve C R', (D.baseChange R').pieces j)
  | .inl j =>
      pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' (fiberChart₀ π)
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) (D.h₀ j)
  | .inr j =>
      pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' (fiberChart₁ π)
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) (D.h₁ j)

/-- The indexed term identification on `1 ⊗ s`: the piece comparison. -/
lemma pieceTermBaseChange_one_tmul (j : D.index) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)) :
    D.pieceTermBaseChange R' j ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) = D.piecesMap R' j s := by
  cases j with
  | inl j =>
      exact pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul R' (fiberChart₀ π)
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) (D.h₀ j) s
  | inr j =>
      exact pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul R' (fiberChart₁ π)
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) (D.h₁ j) s

end FinCoverData
